name: SlashAI
description: Indonesian gateway with an hour-long, 2M-token free trial across its catalogue.
overview: SlashAI is an Indonesian OpenAI-compatible gateway reselling 100-plus models in rupiah, including a free-tier alias (`mimo-auto-free`, 256K context) alongside Claude, GPT and Gemini routes. The signup offer is a single one-hour window of 2,000,000 tokens at 15 requests per minute with no card, so it is a way to benchmark many models quickly rather than a standing allowance.
notes: One trial per account; the free alias is separate from the one-hour window.

models.name: MiMo Auto Free
models.rate_limits: Free trial: 2M tokens in one hour, 15 RPM
